brief:
Chris Hedges read excerpts from his new book "Requiem for Gaza," co-authored with Joe Sacco, at an event held at Labyrinth Books in Princeton, New Jersey. The Chris Hedges Report documented the reading, which was followed by a question-and-answer session with the audience.

The book appears to examine the situation in Gaza through both written and visual storytelling, combining Hedges' reporting with Sacco's illustrated journalism.
